title: After Psych 101
location: A half-empty university lecture hall, Tuesday morning
intro: Psych 101 just let out. Emma — the girl you've ended up sitting next to three Tuesdays in a row — is taking her time packing her bag. The next class doesn't start for ten minutes. You've made small talk with her before, but nothing that stuck.
judgeAddendum: Setting note: this is a quick after-class conversation. Emma and the player are classmates who've barely spoken before — they're acquaintances, not strangers, but there's no romantic context yet. Treat "asking for coffee sometime" or "want to grab lunch" as natural, low-stakes asks that wouldn't be weird if affection is decent. Treat asking for her number as a real ask that requires actual rapport.
